note: What one slot holds, as the GM sees it — the GM channel and GmSnapshot only (threat model 8.3: reveal state, with the epoch, every slot, version numbers and mask keys, is GM yes / participant never / guest never). `stale_text` is alignment requirement 4's 'whether a newer version exists', named for the predicate REVEAL-8 actually fixes: the comparison is of TEXT, not of version numbers, so ten autosaves raise one notice and reverting the text clears it. It is what raises `Table is seeing an earlier version` and its Use latest version. `pending_delivery` is AUD-10: a reveal to a participant with no device yet confirms normally and waits; it never falls back to the table.

valid.name: a name and a portrait, pinned and current
the GM has edited a revealed field since
revealed to a participant who has not joined yet

invalid.name: a mask key that is not revealable for the type
invalid.why: REVEAL-10, ED-5: tags are gm_only by construction, so no slot can be holding them

invalid.name: a mask key of another type
invalid.why: a slot's mask is checked against the type it holds, so a key npc declares cannot appear on a handout

invalid.name: an empty mask
invalid.why: REVEAL-5: an empty mask is not a live slot, it is a Stop

invalid.name: a wildcard mask
invalid.why: REVEAL-9, ED-8: no wildcard is ever stored, so none can be read back out of a slot

invalid.name: a write revision in place of the pinned version
invalid.why: REVEAL-8, CANVAS-34: a slot pins a sealed version number; a write revision is the concurrency token

invalid.name: the revealed text alongside the mask
invalid.why: GM-side state says which keys are live, never what they say — the GM reads the text from the document (EXPORT-12) — an undeclared key is invalid for the server to emit and stripped by a client, so this is a server example

invalid.name: an eligibility class
invalid.why: ED-11: Workbench v1 is mask-only; no class is shown and nothing classifies (M-4) — an undeclared key is invalid for the server to emit and stripped by a client, so this is a server example

invalid.name: no delivery flag
invalid.why: AUD-10: the GM is told plainly when a participant has not joined, so the fact is always present — never absent and guessed
